role: SpawnerAnimals bit for bit: findChunksForSpawning (the eligible chunk set in JDK 8 HashMap order, per-type caps, the pack walk, per-type getCanSpawnHere with light and block rules, onSpawnWithEgg equipment and group data) and performWorldGenSpawning, producing constructed spawn records for the mob lanes.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
function find_chunks: the eligible set is jorder.c's jord_ccp_window, the 289 keys sorted by JDK bin from the player's chunk, no map (lane/gpuorder, L4)
line 972, function ench_tag: malloc of an enchantment NBT text per enchanted equipment stack
line 1651, function pack_walk: while (1) loop bounded only by the pack walk's own break conditions
line 2025, function spawner_world_gen: while (jr_float(walk) < 0.1F), a probabilistic loop with no fixed bound
lines 1574-1580, function sp_mat: material lookup by strcmp on names each call
struct spawner (spawning.h): ensure_chunk and possible_creatures function pointers with void* contexts

recs, boxes, out and the id index are fixed arrays made with the spawner (SP_MAX_RECS, SP_MAX_BOXES, SP_MAX_OUT); records are append-only, so a long run needs the cap (follow-up: recycle a dead mob's record) (lane/gpuarena, L3)
function block_light_do: the five neighbour reads go through block_light_raw, no recursion; egg_on_rider runs the jockeys' chicken and skeleton onSpawnWithEgg, so egg_on does not call itself
notes: Evidence: out/java/spawning (SpawnProbe/SpawnDump) and out/java/snapshots/mobspawn-fast-s1, mobspawn-final-s1, mobspawn-final-s42; out/java/fortress_spawn for the Nether fortress list; out/java/biome_spawn (BiomeSpawnProbe) for every biome's four lists and the swamp hut's witch list, which swamp-night-s2 exercises. spawner_local_difficulty reads the chunk's inhabited_time, which PlayerManager advances (chunkload.c, inhabit-s42). Horses, wolves and ocelots are absent from the lists per world.conf. The bat rule reads a calendar handed in (cal_month, cal_day), not the wall clock. Several World and Chunk member names are taken from comments; WorldServer.func_73057_a (the SRG name for the creature-list lookup) is assumed, not verified. lane/anytick: rec_spawn grows the record array only outside an onSpawnWithEgg (egg_depth): the chicken jockey's nested chicken spawn used to move the record the egg path was writing through. lane/idxentity: spawner_reinforce (EntityZombie's HARD reinforcement: constructor, the caller's 50 tries, the egg); count_entities leaves persistent livings out. lane/envmem: spawner_compact (the park, overworld only) drops the records of mobs gone for good (dead, the only record of their id) and their boxes; recs, boxes and the id index were append-only and aborted at 131072.
